body_html: #edu407 many reader's workshop folks may disagree with me but I also do not think having students choose academic vocabulary words from their independent reading is the best way to support vocabulary development (though independent reading is...) but as a teacher, you can not prepare lessons and decide how to use words in different context. That is hard when students choose vocabulary words.
